basis: The App Store privacy label for this app and the app's App Store description. Draft prepared 10 November 2026; awaiting the developer's confirmation.
summary: SpeedGunner AI collects no data. Video is processed on your device and is never uploaded.
onDevice: Camera video while you measure, processed on your device and not stored or sent anywhere
Your measurements, sessions, Spots, athlete profiles and exports

permissions.name: Camera
permissions.why: To measure speed. Frames are analysed on your device.

permissions.name: LiDAR depth (Pro devices)
permissions.why: To check distance for vehicles within 10 m, on supported iPhone and iPad models.

purchases: Pro is sold through the App Store as a subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Apple handles payment.
extra: Exports (summary images, PDF, CSV) are created on your device and shared only where you send them.
